curated.tagline: Voice companion surface — orb, ghost cursor, agent panel
curated.description: Omarchy shell plugin for Wisp, the resident voice companion: renders wispd's live state as a companion orb with mode badge, cursor-adjacent answer bubble, listening pill, ghost cursor, and a full agent/telemetry panel.
highlights: Companion orb + ghost cursor + listening pill overlays
Pairs with wispd — push-to-talk voice → routed agent actions
